title: Circular 230 practice standards — Ortega & Lin
instructions: Evaluate each action by practitioners at Ortega & Lin under Circular 230.

rows.label: Charging a contingent fee for representing a client in an IRS examination of an original return, with the agreement signed within 120 days of the notice
rows.explanation: §10.27 allows contingent fees in connection with an IRS examination of an original return, if signed within 120 days.

rows.label: Endorsing a client's refund check to pay the firm's fee
rows.explanation: §10.31 bars negotiating a client's refund check.

rows.label: Keeping a client's original records until a fee dispute is settled, though the client needs them to file
rows.explanation: §10.28 requires returning records needed for compliance.

rows.label: Relying in good faith on a client's information without verifying it, absent reason to question it
Considering the chance a position won't be audited when giving written advice
rows.explanation: §10.37 forbids taking the audit lottery into account.

rows.label: Representing two clients with a conflict after informed written consent confirmed within 30 days
rows.explanation: §10.29 permits this with informed consent in writing.
